crossRefs.note: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.
He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat…
All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.
You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on…

parallels.note: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on…
Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for…
If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say…

translations.web: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.
translations.bsb: He is also to burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
translations.kjv: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
translations.asv: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.
